name: Ninomiya Rinko
source:
[i]"As your [b]mama[/b], I'll take good care of you and pamper you."[/i]

The wife of the Ninomiya family who lives next door to the apartment where the Hirose family lives.
She is very motherly and has a good reputation among her neighbors.
Rinko has known [url=https://vndb.org/c122748]Ayato[/url] since he was a small child, and she is always concerned about him as if she were his own mother.
Her young son dislikes getting pampered by his mom. Because of that, she has a strong desire to thoroughly pamper Ayato, whom she has been watching since he was little.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1213893&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
